title: Applied AI Software Engineer, GTM
description:
ABOUT ANTITHESIS

We’re on a mission to redefine how modern distributed systems are tested and released. Our platform is trusted by engineering teams who demand rock-solid reliability, scalable performance, and deep technical visibility. Our platform doesn’t just assure system correctness and reliability, it exists because developers need something better. If you’ve ever experienced the pain of a production outage, had a bad week on-call, or had a release delayed by weeks because of one killer bug - you’ll understand exactly why we’re doing what we do. If you're passionate about developer-first products, system resilience, and correctness, we’d love to talk.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Applied AI Software Engineer to build AI-native products to help our go-to-market and marketing teams.

You’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, data, and GTM operations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Work directly with Sales, Marketing and RevOps to understand how they work, where they get stuck, and how they could do more with technology.

- Design, build, and ship full-stack products that use AI to help non-technical teams get work done.

- Build everything from lightweight agent workflows and automations to production applications for research, enrichment, account scoring, and other GTM problems.

- Make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions. The right solution might use an existing tool, a reusable agent skill, a custom integration, or a full application.

- Partner with RevOps to integrate with the systems that GTM teams use like Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong.

Why Join Us?

- Join a collaborative, kind team supporting a rapidly-growing sales organization.

- Work with the resources - tools, teammates, and world-class experts - to do portfolio-worthy work.

- Use and explore AI in an environment that does not tolerate workslop.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including independently shipping and operating production systems.

- Experience shipping an LLM-powered product, feature, or workflow for real users. You understand the difference between an impressive prototype and a system people can depend on.

- Experience working directly with non-technical users to understand their workflows, test ideas, and improve products through feedback.

- Experience integrating with business systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack, or data-enrichment platforms.

- Strong product and engineering judgment. You can move quickly when the problem calls for an experiment and build for reliability when the solution becomes business critical.

Our current stack for internal GTM applications includes TypeScript, React, LangChain, and AWS. Experience with these tools is helpful, but we care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn.

Job Summary
The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN, is a licensed professional that is expected to function independently in his/her role and is responsible for managing clinically complex caseload of members for one or more lines of business for such as the inpatient settings; acute, subacute, acute rehabilitation, LTAC (Long-Term Acute Care). . The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN is responsible for making the determination of medical necessity and, therefore, benefit coverage for multiple products / lines of business, such as Commercial (FI, SI, and exchange products), state specific Medicaid programs, or Federal programs or in and out of area. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN is expected to demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN will be expected to demonstrate clinical judgement and health plan business knowledge in their decision-making processes, on behalf of the health plan. A working understanding of departmental workflows, policies, and procedures, and understanding of the corporate business goals and objectives. Accountability for outcome measures is critical to the Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN’s success in this role. Provides timely, clinically appropriate, and cost-effective utilization management and discharge planning activities for Point32Health members receiving services at her / his assigned facilities and may be required to float to provide coverage at unassigned facilities. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN will develop effective working relationships with providers to facilitate the transition of the member through their continuum of care following department work processes and policies. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN will be expected to have direct experience with evidence based clinical criteria sets (such as InterQual or MNGs), Point32Health proprietary Medical Necessity Guidelines and product specific payment policies. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN may have responsibility for multiple types of service reimbursement models, depending upon the LOB (Line of Business) and/or assigned facilities contractual arrangements. Examples include but may not be limited to DRG, and/or per diem reimbursement models. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN works under the general direction of the Inpatient Manager of the team/s and the Director of the Department. Job Description
Key Responsibilities/Duties - what you will be doing (top five):

• Provide a range of utilization management (UM) activities for members in an inpatient setting.

• Utilize industry standard / plan proprietary criteria for determining the appropriateness of the inpatient setting on an initial and concurrent review basis, both acute and post-acute (as noted above).

description:
INTITULÉ : « Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs ».
SPÉCIALITÉS : « Qualité de l'air intérieur, Physico-chimie de l'air, Performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments ».
ÉTABLISSEMENT D'AFFECTATION :
École Nationale Supérieure Mines-Télécom Lille Douai dont le nom d'usage est IMT Nord Europe.
Direction / Service : Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE)
Responsable hiérarchique : Directrice du CERI Énergie Environnement
Catégorie : Agent de catégorie A ou contractuel cadre de gestion de catégorie II
Nature du poste : CDI
Lieu de travail : Site de Douai. Des déplacements sur les autres sites de l'École sont à prévoir
CONTEXTE
École sous tutelle du ministère de l'économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, et école de l'Institut Mines Télécom, IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l'innovation et les créations d'entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l'Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1h30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l'ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l'ingénieur et les technologies du digital.
Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d'enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s'appuie sur plus de 20 000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d'excellence dans les domaines suivants :
• Énergie Environnement
• Systèmes Numériques
• Matériaux et Procédés
L'École dispose également d'antennes à Dunkerque, Valenciennes et Alençon.
Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l'Ecole : www.imt-nord-europe.fr
Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Énergie Environnement (CERI EE) ( https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri/ ).
Le CERI EE développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l'efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. Le CERI est structuré en trois axes thématiques : EFT (Énergie, Fluides et Transferts), OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques) et QEI (Qualité des Environnements Intérieurs).
L'axe thématique QEI porte sur l'étude, l'identification et la caractérisation des sources de polluants dans les espaces clos et/ou confinés, l'analyse des interactions entre l'air intérieur et les matériaux, ainsi que l'étude de l'influence des environnements sur l'exposition et le bien-être des occupants. Les enjeux scientifiques traités couvrent plusieurs échelles, depuis l'intégration de matériaux et de systèmes énergétiques innovants jusqu'à leurs impacts sur les espaces intérieurs et leurs occupants. Dans un contexte marqué par le changement climatique et des exigences croissantes en termes de QEI et d'efficacité énergétique, une attention particulière est portée aux stratégies d'adaptation et d'atténuation, ainsi qu'aux rôles du comportement des occupants et des différentes sources d'exposition.
Ce poste vise à renforcer et développer l'axe thématique QEI au sein du CERI. La QEI intègre l'étude de multiples paramètres de confort (température, hygrométrie, bruit, luminosité) et de composition de l'air dans les environnements clos (logements, espaces de travail, transports, etc.), afin d'assurer bien-être et santé des occupants. Why E&C Consultants?
You can read more details here: Becoming an E&Cer, but in big lines:

• We are a Great Place To Work®certified company - employee satisfaction stamped by our staff

• We provide Growth Opportunities - as E&C continues to expand, you grow with us

Why did we decide to create such a role at E&C?
Most of the value in AI is not in the tools themselves. It is in the distance between having access to them and using them well, and that distance is currently being crossed unevenly and informally across the business. This role exists to close that gap deliberately: to make good practice visible and repeatable, to stop capable people from spending hours rediscovering what a colleague solved last month, and to make sure the initiatives we invest in are the ones that actually pay back. Equally, the role exists to apply judgement about where AI is not the answer - an honest recommendation to keep a process manual, or to solve it with a spreadsheet, a script or a conversation, is as valuable as an automation delivered.
What would you be trusted with if you join us?

• Identify and prioritize AI use cases by working with teams to understand pain points, expected value, feasibility and data sensitivity

• Measure and report business impact (usage, hours returned, cycle‑time improvements, automated workflows, cost vs benefit)

• Be a point of contact for our E&Cers for AI questions & ideas

• Design and deliver targeted training, policies & guidance ( with the help of our amazing HR and Admin teams ) , workshops and knowledge sessions tailored to different audiences and technical confidence levels.

• Shape a network of AI champions embedded across functions to sustain capability building

• Partner with IT to ensure AI use aligns with information security, data governance and records requirements, help mitigate risks (client confidentiality, personal data, IP, output accuracy and appropriate human oversight)

It’s a very new role - so, fair question: what success looks like?
In 12 months we’d hope for:

• Increased enthusiasm and awareness of sensible usage of AI solutions (yes, we know, that’s not something you can really control, but we are all here to support you in making it happen!)

• A clear, documented pathway from idea to deployed AI solution, understood and used across the business

• Measurable growth in active, competent use of approved AI tools: not licences issued, but work genuinely being done differently

• A published set of AI guidelines that E&Cers can find, understand and follow, aligned with our security and data governance

• A maintained inventory of AI tools and use cases , with costs and benefits overview

• An active AI champions network reducing reliance on this role as the single point of support

• Reduced duplication across AI initiatives - which investments are returning value and which should stop?

Requirements
What makes you the perfect match?

• Not a surprising one - we count on deep, hands-on fluency with current generative AI tools , including assistants, agentic workflows and automation platforms, together with the habit of staying current as the field moves

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Overview
Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products - often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.
We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.
This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.
How this role operates
You'll partner with Product and Engineering early - shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.
Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.
Responsibilities
· Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration
· Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements
· Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns
· Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it
· Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system - defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used
· Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it
· Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools
· Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on
· Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling
Qualifications
· 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through
· Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment - not just consuming one
· Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems
· Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.
· Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive
· Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward
· Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.
Qualities we're looking for
· Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.
· Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer - and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.
· Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.
· Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.
· Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.
Portfolio
· Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.
· Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.
Nice to have
· Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions
· Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts
· Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

- Stakeholder management without authority: Strong persuasion and communication skills to align engineers, design, Commercial, and Operations behind product decisions without formal reporting authority.

title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

- Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

- Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

- Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

- Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

- Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

- Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

- Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) i

title: Client Services Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Client Services Specialist who can take genuine ownership of our client relationships.
Your job is to make sure clients feel supported, informed, and confident in the work we’re doing together. You’ll keep commitments moving, spot risks before they become problems, and ensure that important details don’t disappear into an inbox, meeting, or Slack thread.

This is not a reactive customer-support role. It’s also not a role where “following up” simply means asking everybody else for an update.

We need someone who can understand what a client is trying to achieve, coordinate the work required to get them there, and confidently own the communication along the way.

What you’ll be responsible for

• Build strong, trusted relationships with our clients.

• Understand each client’s goals, priorities, expectations, and current sentiment.

• Serve as the bridge between clients and the internal team.

• Lead client meetings and turn conversations into clear decisions, owners, and deadlines.

• Make sure every commitment is properly recorded and followed through.

• Keep ClickUp and client records accurate enough that another team member can confidently step in when needed.

• Proactively communicate progress, delays, risks, and changes-before clients need to ask.

• Identify unhappy, disengaged, or at-risk clients early and coordinate an appropriate response.

• Manage onboarding, ongoing client rhythms, milestones, renewals, and cancellations with care.

• Coordinate smooth handovers and coverage when somebody is out of office.

• Escalate issues with context, possible solutions, and a clear recommendation.

• Help improve the systems and processes we use to deliver a consistently excellent client experience.

What success looks like:

• Clients know what is happening and what comes next.

• Internal team members understand exactly what they own.

• Commitments have named owners and realistic due dates.

• Risks are surfaced early rather than discovered during a crisis.

• Client information is current, clear, and easy to find.

• Meetings end with decisions and action, not additional confusion.

• Leave and handovers do not disrupt the client experience.

• Leadership does not need to chase you for updates or remind you about follow-ups.

• Clients see you as a trusted partner rather than simply a point of contact.

You’ll probably be great at this if you:

• Are naturally warm, thoughtful, and confident with people.

• Communicate clearly without sounding robotic or overly corporate.

• Have excellent follow-through and notice when something is about to fall through a gap.

• Can bring structure to situations that are still slightly messy.

• Take ownership without waiting to be told about every next step.

• Are comfortable having honest conversations when expectations, scope, or timelines need to be addressed.

• Can distinguish between something urgent, something important, and something that can wait.

• Stay calm when a client is frustrated.

• Ask good questions and listen closely to the answers.

• Enjoy creating clarity, improving processes, and leaving things better documented than you found them.

• Can work independently while keeping the right people informed.

This role may not suit you if

• You need detailed instructions before taking action.

• You avoid difficult client conversations.

• You regularly rely on memory instead of documenting information.

• You consider sending a message to be the same as completing the follow-through.

• You wait for a client to complain before addressing a concern.

• You enjoy talking to clients but dislike the operational work required behind the scenes.

• You need frequent chasing to close loops.

Experience

• We care more about judgment, ownership, and communication than a perfect CV

• Experience in client success, WordPress development, Google Analytics and good understanding of technical SEO, account management, project coordination, or a service-based bus

title: Investigator, Special Investigative Unit
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides investigative support for special investigation unit (SIU) activities. Responsible for supporting for the prevention, detection, investigation, reporting, and when appropriate, recovery of money related to health care fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA). Responsible for reviewing and analyzing information to draw conclusions on allegations of FWA and/or may determine appropriateness of care, and recognizing and adhering to national and local coding and billing guidelines in order to maintain coding accuracy and excellence.
Essential Job Duties

• Responsible for developing leads presented to the special investigation unit (SIU) to assess and determine whether potential fraud, waste, or abuse (FWA) is corroborated by evidence.
• Conducts both preliminary assessments of FWA allegations, and end-to-end investigations, including but not limited to witness interviews, background checks, data analytics to identify outlier billing behavior, contract and program regulation research, provider and member education, findings identification and communications development, recommendations and preparation of overpayment identifications, and closure of investigative cases.
• Completes investigations within the mandated period of time required by either state and/or federal contracts and/or regulations.
• Conducts both on-site and desktop investigations.
• Conducts low to medium, and extensive investigations, including reviews of medical records and data analysis, and makes determinations as to whether the investigation and/or audit identified potential FWA.
• Performs accurate and reliable medical review audits that may also include coding and billing reviews.
• Produces audit reports for internal and external review.
• Coordinates with various internal customers (e.g., provider services, contracting and credentialing, healthcare services, member services, claims, etc.), to gather documentation pertinent to investigations.
• Detects potential health care FWA through the identification of aberrant coding and/or billing patterns through utilization review.
• Prepares appropriate FWA referrals to regulatory agencies and law enforcement.
• Documents appropriately all case related information in the case management system in an accurate manner, including storage of case documentation following SIU related requirements.
• Prepares detailed preliminary and extensive investigation referrals to state and/or federal regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies when FWA is identified as required by regulatory and/or contract requirements.
• Renders provider education on appropriate practices (e.g., coding) as appropriate based on national or local guidelines, contractual, and/or regulatory requirements.
• Interacts with regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies regarding case investigations.
• Prepares audit results letters to providers when overpayments are identified.
• Ensures compliance with applicable contractual requirements, and federal and state regulations.
• Complies with SIU policies as and procedures as well as goals set by SIU leadership.

title: Senior HR Business Consultant
description:
Jij maakt het mogelijk
Een CEO die met 80 mensen een reorganisatie in moet en jou belt voordat hij het zijn MT vertelt. Een leiderschapsteam dat jouw hulp inroept omdat het na twee jaar hard groeien merkt dat de oude manier van werken vastloopt. Een collega-VIE'er die bij een eerste groot veranderproject even met je wil sparren over hoe ze de weerstand in het team aanpakt. En dat is slechts een deel van je werkweek.
Als Senior HR Business Consultant ben je de sparringpartner van founders, CEO's en MT's van ambitieuze groeibedrijven en werk je voor meerdere bedrijven tegelijkertijd. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie van 40 naar 150 mensen gaat en je helpt ze daar doorheen: organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur, performance. Vooral verandering is jouw ding. Je weet dat een nieuwe structuur bedenken makkelijk is en dat het echte werk begint zodra mensen er iets van gaan vinden.
Je kijkt ook verder dan je eigen opdrachten: waar kunnen we een klant nog beter helpen, welke nieuwe klant past bij ons, wat hebben we nodig om te groeien? VIE staat voor een volgende stap en we willen dat jij een van de mensen bent die mee gaat bouwen aan onze organisatie.
Requirements
Jij hebt het
Je hebt ruime ervaring in HR, als HR-lead , HR-manager, coach, veranderkundige of consultant, en je hebt aan tafel gezeten bij een MT. Je hebt organisaties zien groeien, krimpen of veranderen en kan goed tegen verandering. Verder herken je jezelf hierin:

• Je hebt mensen aangestuurd en je vindt het oprecht leuk om anderen beter te maken. Je geeft feedback die ergens over gaat en je trekt je team mee zonder alles zelf te willen doen.

• Je denkt commercieel. Je ziet kansen bij klanten, je durft het gesprek over een vervolgopdracht aan te gaan en je vindt het niet vies om over omzet te praten.

• Je hebt verandertrajecten geleid en weet hoe je een organisatie meekrijgt.

• Je bent ondernemend en wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren.

• Je gelooft meer in de waarde van een goede confrontatie dan in de status quo behouden. Daarom stel je de vraag achter de vraag, ook als dat ongemakkelijk is. En als je vastloopt, vraag je hulp.

• Je gebruikt tech en AI in je werk omdat je snapt dat het je tijd geeft voor wat er echt toe doet.

• Je begrijpt hoe organisaties werken en kan HR-overstijgend meedenken en kijken.

• Je voelt je thuis bij onze kernwaarden: samen doen, oprecht direct en beter maken.

Dit verdien jij

• Een team collega's met samen honderden jaren People & Culture-ervaring, en een plek waar je die ervaring zelf ook doorgeeft

• Werk bij uiteenlopende groeibedrijven, met ondernemers die weten wat ze willen (of juist niet, en daar help je dan bij)

• Regie over je eigen agenda en de vrijheid om nationale feestdagen op te nemen wanneer het voor jou belangrijk is en autonomie over je eigen werk

• Tijd om je in te zetten voor een goed doel of vrijwilligerswerk. We zijn niet voor niets een B Corp

• Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring en bij deze rol binnen de range van € 5.083 - € 6.877, plus de rest van onze voorwaarden die je hier vindt

Hoe verder?
Nieuwsgierig? Laten we koffie drinken, gerust eerst gewoon om kennis te maken. Neem direct contact op met Wouter, CEO van VIE People , via of +31 (0) 6 506 025 72.
